name: LLM fundamental scores, monthly forward test (Claude from 2026-10-01, GPT-6.1 Sol from 2026-11-05)
verdict: Monthly LLM scores of the 200 largest companies, forward test: claude-opus-5-5 for 2 months, then gpt-6.1-sol from 2026-11-05 (a new test). PASS after 12 runs of one model if mean 1-month rank IC > 0 (t > 1) and the top 20 beat equal weight; KILL if IC <= 0.
